# iOS 离线策略候选及验收边界

本策略只面向 `lizhao-office-pdf` 专用 LibreOffice iOS 静态内核，不是通用 LibreOffice 安全加固，也不是 iOS 进程沙盒。固定官方 tag `libreoffice-26.2.6.3`、commit `8221e31b3ac356a1623c672912a3d2b492f7e3d1`。目前 `qualified=false`，没有 Apple 编译及设备观测结果。严禁将“源码补丁精确应用”解释为“严格离线已证明”。

## 真实源码出口与本次处理

| 固定源码位置 | 上游行为 | 候选处理 | 尚未证明的边界 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `desktop/source/lib/init.cxx` Kit 加载入口 | 识别宏选项；更新模式仍留在 TODO | iOS 强制 `MacroExecMode::NEVER_EXECUTE`，真实 media descriptor 添加 `UpdateDocMode::NO_UPDATE` | 所有格式的宏、链接、嵌入对象是否都服从加载合同，须恶意样本验证 |
| `ucb/source/core/ucb.cxx` 私有 `queryContentProvider` | 对 URI 匹配 provider，并可取解析后的 provider | iOS 只放行 `file:///`、`private:`、`vnd.sun.star.tdoc:`；拒绝 HTTP、HTTPS、FTP、SMB、展开式和其他包装协议 | 本地文件仍是内核正常工作所需；此处不对本地文件实现完整任务目录隔离，不能宣称阻断所有外部本地引用 |
| `sal/osl/unx/socket.cxx` | 正向/反向 DNS、OSL socket 创建 | iOS 正向 DNS 返回 `EAI_FAIL`，反向 DNS 返回空，socket 创建返回空并置 `EACCES` | 只封闭 LO OSL API；原生系统、第三方库或框架直接调用网络的旁路尚须审计和设备流量观测 |
| `ucb/source/ucp/webdav-curl/CurlSession.cxx` 实际 curl 传输位置 | `curl_multi_perform` 驱动传输 | iOS 在传输前抛出 `DAV_HTTP_CONNECT`，避免直接取得 WebDAV provider 后绕过 broker | 不等于封闭发行构建中的每个 libcurl 调用者 |
| `sax/source/expatwrap/sax_expat.cxx` 外部实体回调 | 可委派 entity resolver 获取流并创建外部解析器 | iOS 返回 false，交由 Expat 报告外部实体解析失败 | 不覆盖所有可能的 XML 解析库、XML 路径或本地读取 API |

修改均为 `#if defined(IOS)` 分支；不对宿主应用使用符号插桩、socket 钩子或全局 NSURL 协议拦截。该专用内核若与其他 LibreOffice 组件同时链接，策略影响整个被链接的 LO，必须评估冲突。协议白名单有意保守，可能拒绝合法文档的特殊内部内容；四格式实测前不承诺格式保真。

`native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/offline-policy.json` 保存每个原始文件完整 SHA-256、精确替换锚点、结果完整 SHA-256；`native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/offline-policy.patch` 供人工审阅。两者必须逐字一致。保留上游各源文件原有许可证头；补丁应用后的内核继续受上游及第三方许可证约束。

## 应用、验证与身份

```sh
python3 native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/apply_offline_policy.py --source /path/to/libreoffice-ios
python3 native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/apply_offline_policy.py --source /path/to/libreoffice-ios --check
```

路径为实际获取的官方源码。应用前核对 HEAD/tag commit、Git 中原始文件字节、无暂存改动、无策略外受跟踪改动、无路径越界或符号链接、全部锚点唯一。全部文件通过验证后才写入。原始和已修改文件混合时拒绝自动补齐，用户改动不会被覆盖。重复应用只允许全部结果与回执已匹配的情况。构建器自动再次 `--check`，只接受规定的补丁差异；不会要求补丁后伪装成干净源码。

源码回执 `.office-pdf-offline-policy.json` 是构建身份记录，包含策略清单 SHA-256；不是签名、权限或离线资格证书。资源清单携带同一记录，ObjC++ 编译时内嵌相同 SHA-256并验证资源副本，`BUILD.json` 另记 shim 源码 SHA-256、Apple 链接与设备状态。构建机器控制者仍可以修改工具，不能把本地 JSON 当作不可伪造信任根。

封装器不能只读取已存在的静态库：它核对构建目录的真实 SRCDIR 后，使用 GNU Make 4.2 或以上直接调用固定上游 `Makefile.gbuild`，将全部 5 个补丁源的绝对路径传给 `--what-if`，真实执行 `build` 并要求成功，然后重新核对源码策略、构建配置和静态输入。直接进入 gbuild 的原因是上游顶层 `Makefile.in` 会递归启动编译依赖图，不能假定 `-W` 自动传递。`BUILD.json` 保存该命令与重建后受控源码 SHA；它不把触碰时间戳或原先的 archive 当作新补丁已编译的证据。

## 可运行的候选验收路径

```sh
python3 native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/build_kernel.py \
  --source /path/to/libreoffice-ios --build /path/to/libreoffice-build \
  --resources /path/to/ios-install-root --output /path/to/new-candidate \
  --acceptance-only
```

`--acceptance-only` 仅编译启用 `OfficePdfKernelAcceptanceConvertJSON` 独立 C ABI；接收与生产预备链相同的 JSON 参数，使用同一资源核验、Kit 进程单例、长期 profile、互斥占槽、密码拒绝和 PDF 导出流程，结果带 `testOnly=true`。未传该标志时此 ABI 返回 `KERNEL_ACCEPTANCE_ENTRY_DISABLED`。`OfficePdfKernelConvertJSON` 生产入口在两种构建中均继续返回 `IOS_OFFLINE_POLICY_UNQUALIFIED`；任意请求 JSON、资源清单和环境变量都不能解除。

候选 probe 始终 `available=false/strictOffline=false`；验收构建额外 `testOnly=true/acceptanceOnly=true`。因此它不能直接成为当前业务基座中可用的五 API 转换内核，生产 Swift/UTS 仍应拒绝；还需要明确隔离的原生验收调用方、Apple 编译/链接、签名与设备数据。此目录本次未添加或声称已有验收 App。后续完整宿主联调路径应根据真实构建产物另行落实，不能只将门禁常量改为 true。

固定上游 `configure.ac` 使用 iOS device/simulator 最低 **14.5**。封装的 target 与 framework `MinimumOSVersion` 同为 14.5，不承诺 iOS 13/14.0 或当前不存在的 simulator slice。

## 必须补齐的资格证据

1. 固定 commit、策略 SHA、构建配置、静态输入、资源与设备安装包身份一致；真实 Apple ObjC++ 编译、全量链接、完整宿主 SwiftCompile。
2. DOC/DOCX/PPT/PPTX 成功样本的多页内容、中文/字体、图片、布局、页数与 PDFKit 校验；多任务连续运行及进程级 profile 生命周期。
3. HTTP/HTTPS、域名及 IP、DNS/反向 DNS、重定向、代理、FTP/SMB、宏、DDE、远程模板、外链图片、OLE、XML 外部实体和本地文件引用样本；结果、错误及流量/访问观测均须保留。不能把系统断网或权限拒绝当成内核策略通过。
4. 关闭网络的正常转换与打开网络的恶意样本对照；无未解释外联。继续审计直接 POSIX、CFNetwork、libcurl 其他调用者、XML 库和本地读取旁路，针对实际链接集合收敛覆盖面。
5. 超时不能强杀 iOS 进程内 Kit；load/save 未返回时维持 draining、阻止新任务、丢弃迟到结果，不能因候选验收放宽回调与回收合同。

Windows 可验证精确补丁与拒绝路径，但不能完成以上 Apple 与设备验收，不能据此启用生产。

## 官方固定源码

- [Kit 加载入口](https://github.com/LibreOffice/core/blob/8221e31b3ac356a1623c672912a3d2b492f7e3d1/desktop/source/lib/init.cxx)
- [UCB provider 分发](https://github.com/LibreOffice/core/blob/8221e31b3ac356a1623c672912a3d2b492f7e3d1/ucb/source/core/ucb.cxx)
- [OSL DNS 与 socket](https://github.com/LibreOffice/core/blob/8221e31b3ac356a1623c672912a3d2b492f7e3d1/sal/osl/unx/socket.cxx)
- [curl WebDAV 传输](https://github.com/LibreOffice/core/blob/8221e31b3ac356a1623c672912a3d2b492f7e3d1/ucb/source/ucp/webdav-curl/CurlSession.cxx)
- [Expat 外部实体](https://github.com/LibreOffice/core/blob/8221e31b3ac356a1623c672912a3d2b492f7e3d1/sax/source/expatwrap/sax_expat.cxx)
- [iOS 14.5 构建下限](https://github.com/LibreOffice/core/blob/8221e31b3ac356a1623c672912a3d2b492f7e3d1/configure.ac#L4016)

# lizhao-office-pdf iOS 同内核移植候选

本目录将 Android 使用的 LibreOffice `libreoffice-26.2.6.3` 转换链迁移为 iOS 静态链接候选源码。支持目标为 DOC、DOCX、PPT、PPTX。当前没有 Apple 编译、链接、运行或转换效果证据，目录中没有编造的 framework。**不是已可运行的 iOS 发布内核**。

## 原生边界

- `native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/include/OfficePdfKernel.h`：Swift 可通过 `canImport(OfficePdfKernel)` 导入的 C ABI。
- `native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/src/OfficePdfKernel.mm`：Kit 初始化、密码拒绝、文档类型核对、PDF 导出和对象回收。
- `OfficePdfKernelProbeJSON(bundlePath)`：当前固定 `available=false`、`strictOffline=false`、`supportsHardCancel=false`，原因 `IOS_OFFLINE_POLICY_UNQUALIFIED`。读取资源清单或修改任意 JSON 均不能解除此门禁。
- `OfficePdfKernelConvertJSON(requestJSON)`：生产入口同样拒绝未通过离线资格的内核。预备转换链使用同 tag 的 `lok_init_2 → documentLoadWithOptions → getDocumentType → initializeForRendering → saveAs(pdf) → destroy`。iOS 下定义 `IOS`，由官方头直接调用静态链接的 `libreofficekit_hook_2`。
- `OfficePdfKernelAcceptanceConvertJSON(requestJSON)`：仅 `--acceptance-only` 构建开启的独立原生验收入口，结果标注 `testOnly=true`；生产入口仍拒绝。候选不能直接用于当前业务基座的五 API 转换，验收调用方和完整宿主联调尚未落实。
- 两个 JSON 函数返回独立分配的 UTF-8 字符串，Swift 必须调用 `OfficePdfKernelFreeString`。极端内存不足可返回空指针，调用方须作为真实失败处理。

转换请求为 JSON 对象，包含绝对沙盒路径 `inputPath`、`outputPath`、`resourcePath`、`profilePath`（Application Support 下插件长期专属目录），`format`（doc/docx/ppt/pptx），`deadlineUptimeMs`（系统开机单调时间毫秒）及调用方关联用的 `taskId`。不接收客户提供的 UNO 参数。输出路径不得存在，原始输入不得被覆盖。`resourcePath` 必须是主 App 包内 `OfficePdfKernelResources.bundle` 的 POSIX 规范绝对路径，不含 NUL，且 POSIX `realpath` 的结果必须与传入字符串完全一致。调用方仅可对可信 `Bundle.main` 派生的固定资源根取得 POSIX 规范结果，再原样发送；Foundation 的 resolving/standardizing 可能把 `/private/var` 简写成 `/var`，不能用它们的显示结果代替物理路径身份。C 层不会把外部别名或符号链接自动规范化后放行；点段、重复分隔符等非规范根、资源路径链接及已有文件身份/大小/SHA 违规仍按原错误路径拒绝。该规则修复合法物理根因 Foundation 显示差异被误拒的问题，不表示已通过 iOS 运行或私有调用方接线。C 层核对 `OfficePdfKernelManifest.json` 的相对路径、文件大小和 SHA-256，清单不能解除离线门禁。配置/字体/registry 的实际启动布局仍须用 Apple 运行确认。

成功候选结果是 `type=success/sourceFormat/engineVersion/released`；失败是 `type=fail/reason/nativeCode/message/released`。PDF 大小/魔数/页数、原子提交以及对外业务回调由 Swift 桥继续校验，不能仅凭 `saveAs` 返回成功交付。

Kit 调用通过全局互斥串行执行，密码回调只使用官方 `setDocumentPassword(..., nullptr)` 放弃打开，不请求/猜测密码。每任务销毁文档并注销回调；Kit 为进程级单例，首次初始化后保留到 App 进程退出，不调用每任务 Kit destroy。长期 profile 不属于任务临时目录，不能被任务清理删除；后续资源/profile 身份变化或首次初始化失败会拒绝执行，需应用进程重启。回调上下文在注销前始终存活。不可从另一个线程销毁正在 load/save 的对象。iOS 为进程内调用，无法照搬 Android 的隔离 service、杀进程和 Linux seccomp。超时只能在 Kit 返回后的边界检测；调用尚未返回时 Swift 必须保持占槽和 draining 状态，拒绝新转换，丢弃迟到结果。

## Mac 构建准备

需要自行准备 Mac/Xcode、LibreOffice 官方构建先决条件以及足够磁盘/内存。本脚本只使用 Python 标准库、Git、make 和 Apple 工具，不安装新依赖，也不从 Android APK 复制 `.so` 或资源冒充 iOS 库。

1. 获取官方源码并固定 `libreoffice-26.2.6.3` tag，固定已从官方 Git tag 解引用取得的 HEAD commit `8221e31b3ac356a1623c672912a3d2b492f7e3d1`，并检查配置构建的 SRCDIR 指向此源码；遵循上游 iOS 配置完成全量构建。官方配置包含 `--host=arm64-apple-ios`：

   ```sh
   git clone --branch libreoffice-26.2.6.3 --depth 1 https://github.com/LibreOffice/core.git libreoffice-ios
   cd libreoffice-ios
   python3 /path/to/native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/apply_offline_policy.py --source .
   python3 /path/to/native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/build_compat.py --source .
   ./autogen.sh --with-distro=LibreOfficeiOS
   make
   ```

   补丁脚本路径由实际克隆位置决定，`/path/to/` 不代表交付目录。除本地候选补丁外，以上是上游构建入口；SDK/构建依赖、codesign 和资源复制并未在当前 Windows 环境执行。固定 tag 的 `configure.ac` 硬编码 iOS 最低 **14.5**；封装 target 与 framework 清单保持 14.5，不承诺 iOS 13/14.0。官方 iOS 配置并未承诺禁用全部网络访问、外部内容和宏。不能把 `--disable-online-update` 或禁用 TLS 视为完整离线保障。

2. 从该构建整理真实 iOS 资源根（须包含 `program/`、`share/`、`rc`、`fundamentalrc`、`ICU.dat`，其余 registry、字体、启动资源必须完整保留）。运行下述脚本，参数均为用户准备或构建生成的路径，不是本插件随附目录：

   ```sh
   python3 native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/build_kernel.py \
     --source /path/to/libreoffice-ios \
     --build /path/to/libreoffice-ios \
     --resources /path/to/ios-install-root \
     --output /path/to/new-office-pdf-ios-build
   ```

   `--build` 必须含真实 `config_host.mk`。脚本从该配置导出的环境调用官方 `bin/lo-all-static-libs`，收集 `.a` **及 NSS 单独 `.o`**；拒绝未展开通配符、越出构建根的文件和非纯 arm64 输入。源码 tag/commit、精确补丁、策略回执、策略外改动、iOS/arm64 配置、资源清单均检查。补丁清单 SHA-256 写入编译常量、资源清单及 BUILD，禁止漂移后继续封装。当前要求源码构建路径不含空格，上游清单输出本身未引用路径。若只为独立原生验收，另加 `--acceptance-only`；不加时验收 ABI 也拒绝执行。

3. 脚本优先使用 `gmake`，拒绝低于固定上游要求的 GNU Make 4.2；收集器在包含配置前设置 `gb_Side := host`，使 `config_host_lang.mk` 正确展开。核对 build/source 身份后，直接进入上游 `Makefile.gbuild`，以 `--what-if` 指定 5 个补丁源绝对路径并真实执行 `build`，成功后再复核策略/配置并重新收集输入。这样不能用“先构建旧库、后应用补丁、直接封装”的顺序给旧 `.a` 标记新策略身份；实际 Make 命令和受控源码 SHA 写入 BUILD。构建工作日志由外层 CI 保存，不能把 dry-run 或时间戳检查当成编译通过。

   随后编译 ObjC++ 和 `native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/src/OfficePdfRegistration.cxx`。后者包含真实 `workdir/CustomTarget/ios/native-code.h` 及同构建生成配置头，按上游 `-C` 生成约定保留 C 链接；Apple `nm` 必须检出未被 C++ 改名的 `lo_get_factory_map`、`lo_get_constructor_map` 才能归档。注册头和配置头的 SHA 一并记录。合并真实 archive 后再用 `-force_load` 链接 iOS device 可执行探针并检查 Mach-O 平台。缺少系统 Framework、注册定义或依赖时直接失败，不能把归档成功当成链接成功。静态依赖/系统框架列表仍可能需根据真实 Apple 链接错误调整；本轮未声称已经成功。

4. 成功输出才包含 `OfficePdfKernel.framework`、`OfficePdfKernelResources.bundle`、`AppRootResources/ICU.dat`、`link-probe` 和 `BUILD.json`。清单记录源码 commit、Xcode、每个静态输入/资源/产物的大小与 SHA-256，`appleLinkVerified=true` 只表示本脚本的探针链接成功；`deviceRuntimeVerified=false/strictOffline=false/available=false` 继续保留。输出目录已存在时拒绝覆盖。必须把生成的 `AppRootResources/ICU.dat` 复制进最终 App 主 bundle 根目录；上游 iOS 从 `NSBundle.mainBundle` 硬编码读取该文件，C 层校验主 bundle 副本与清单 SHA 一致，仅把 ICU 放在子 bundle 不可用。`rc/fundamentalrc` 的实际变量和注册路径仍需真实 iOS 启动验证。没有模拟器 slice，不得宣称支持模拟器或直接添加假的 XCFramework slice。

## 尚需解决的上线门槛

1. `native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/offline-policy.json` 与 `native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/offline-policy.patch` 已提供固定 commit 的 5 文件候选补丁：Kit 宏/更新模式、UCB 协议分发、OSL DNS/socket、WebDAV curl 实际传输与 Expat 外部实体。详情及未覆盖旁路见 `native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/OFFLINE_POLICY.md`。目前只验证精确应用及漂移拒绝，没有 Apple/设备离线资格。
2. 实证禁用宏、自动更新/外部链接以及交互。上游 `UpdateDocMode` 仍是 TODO，候选在真实 Kit media descriptor 中加入 `NO_UPDATE`，并在 iOS 分支强制 `NEVER_EXECUTE`，不依赖客户选项。此源码处理不替代宏样本/外链样本、网络与本地引用的设备实测，更不能代替完整网络出口阻断；禁止删除生产门禁。
3. 将容器/关系检查、限额、沙盒边界与 Android 同一批成功/恶意样本对照；嵌入 OLE、CFB 宏与外链同样需要覆盖。输入验证不等于内核网络隔离。

class InspectionError(ValueError):
    pass

def require(value, code):
    if not value:
        raise InspectionError(code)

def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

def check_deadline(deadline):
    if deadline is not None:
        require(time.monotonic() < deadline,'inspection deadline exceeded')

def read_checked(stream, size, deadline):
    check_deadline(deadline)
    raw = stream.read(size)
    check_deadline(deadline)  # EOF/最后一块也不得绕过时限。
    require(isinstance(raw,bytes) and len(raw)<=size,'read contract violated')
    return raw

def strict_json(raw):
    def pairs(items):
        result={}
        for key,value in items:
            require(key not in result,'duplicate JSON key')
            result[key]=value
        return result
    try:
        return json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8'),object_pairs_hook=pairs,
                          parse_constant=lambda value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(InspectionError('nonfinite JSON number')))
    except (UnicodeError,json.JSONDecodeError):

def safe_components(path, must_exist=True):
    path=Path(path).absolute()
    require('..' not in path.parts,'filesystem parent traversal')
    for item in (*reversed(path.parents),path):
        if not os.path.lexists(item):
            require(not must_exist or item != path,'missing filesystem input')
            continue
        info=item.lstat()
        require(not stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode) and not getattr(info,'st_file_attributes',0)&0x400,
                'filesystem link or reparse point')
        if item!=path:
            require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode),'filesystem non-directory ancestor')
    return path

def stat_identity(info):
    return {'device':info.st_dev,'inode':info.st_ino,'mode':info.st_mode,'links':info.st_nlink,
            'bytes':info.st_size,'mtimeNs':info.st_mtime_ns,'ctimeNs':info.st_ctime_ns}

@contextmanager
def pinned_regular(path, size):
    path=safe_components(path)
    before=path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_nlink==1 and before.st_size==size,'ordinary independent input size')
    flags=os.O_RDONLY|getattr(os,'O_BINARY',0)|getattr(os,'O_NOFOLLOW',0)|getattr(os,'O_NONBLOCK',0)
    fd=os.open(path,flags)
    stream=os.fdopen(fd,'rb')
    primary=None; secondary=[]
    try:
        opened=os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        require(all(getattr(before,key)==getattr(opened,key) for key in STAT_FIELDS),'input changed while opening')
        yield stream,stat_identity(opened)
    except BaseException as error:
        primary=error
        raise
    finally:
        try:
            after=os.fstat(stream.fileno())
            current=path.lstat()
            require(all(getattr(before,key)==getattr(after,key)==getattr(current,key) for key in STAT_FIELDS)
                    and not getattr(current,'st_file_attributes',0)&0x400,'input changed during read')
        except BaseException as error:
            secondary.append(type(error).__name__)
        try:
            stream.close()
        except BaseException as error:
            secondary.append(type(error).__name__)
        if secondary:
            if primary is None:
                raise InspectionError('input stability or close failed')
            primary.inspection_secondary_failures=secondary

def small_pinned(path, size, digest, deadline):
    with pinned_regular(path,size) as (stream,identity):
        raw=read_checked(stream,size+1,deadline)
        require(len(raw)==size and sha(raw)==digest,'small input SHA or size mismatch')
        return raw,identity

def clean_name(name):
    require(isinstance(name,str) and 0<len(name)<=2048 and len(name.encode('utf-8'))<=4096,'tar path length')
    require(not name.startswith('/') and '\\' not in name,'tar path absolute or backslash')
    parts=name.split('/')
    require(parts[0]=='candidate' and all(part not in ('','.','..') for part in parts),'tar path root or traversal')
    for part in parts:
        require(not part.endswith((' ','.')) and not RESERVED.fullmatch(part),'Windows trailing or reserved alias')
        require(not any(ord(ch)<32 or ord(ch)==127 or ch in '<>:"|?*' for ch in part),'Windows control or alternate-stream path')
        require(re.fullmatch(r'.*~[0-9]+(?:\.[^.]*)?',part) is None,'Windows short-name alias')
    return name

def alias(name):
    return unicodedata.normalize('NFC',name).casefold()

def mtime_ns(text):
    try:
        value=Decimal(text)
        require(value.is_finite(),'mtime finite exact nanoseconds')
        parts=value.as_tuple()
        digits=parts.digits
        first=next((index for index,digit in enumerate(digits) if digit),len(digits))
        if first==len(digits):
            return 0
        digits=digits[first:]
        shift=parts.exponent+9
        # 不进行Decimal乘法或舍入：系数尾部只有全零才能精确消去亚纳秒位。
        if shift<0:
            cut=-shift
            require(cut<=len(digits) and not any(digits[-cut:]),'mtime finite exact nanoseconds')
            digits=digits[:-cut]
            shift=0
        # 先限位数再用小整数计算，巨大科学记数指数不会触发巨型幂或整数转换。
        require(len(digits)+shift<=19,'mtime finite exact nanoseconds')
        result=0
        for digit in digits:
            result=result*10+digit
        result*=10**shift
        require(result<=2**63-1,'mtime finite exact nanoseconds')
        return -result if parts.sign else result
    except (InvalidOperation,TypeError,ValueError) as error:
        if isinstance(error,InspectionError):raise
        raise InspectionError('invalid archive mtime') from None

class SingleGzipReader:
    """有界单member gzip；zlib校CRC/ISIZE，拒绝拼接member和包括零字节在内的尾部。"""
    def __init__(self,stream,spec,deadline):
        self.stream,self.spec,self.deadline=stream,spec,deadline
        self.decoder=zlib.decompressobj(31)
        self.pending=b''; self.buffer=bytearray(); self.finished=False
        self.compressed=0; self.expanded=0; self.digest=hashlib.sha256()

    def read(self,size):
        check_deadline(self.deadline)
        require(type(size) is int and 0<size<=CHUNK,'bounded gzip read request')
        while len(self.buffer)<size and not self.finished:
            check_deadline(self.deadline)
            if not self.pending:
                self.pending=read_checked(self.stream,CHUNK,self.deadline)
                self.compressed+=len(self.pending); self.digest.update(self.pending)
                require(self.compressed<=self.spec.payload_bytes,'compressed input bound')
                require(self.pending,'truncated gzip member')
            previous=len(self.pending)
            try:
                data=self.decoder.decompress(self.pending,size-len(self.buffer))
            except zlib.error:
                raise InspectionError('gzip CRC ISIZE or deflate integrity') from None
            self.pending=self.decoder.unconsumed_tail
            require(not self.decoder.unused_data,'gzip trailing data or concatenated member')
            self.expanded+=len(data)
            require(self.expanded<=self.spec.max_tar_bytes,'tar uncompressed bound')
            self.buffer.extend(data)
            check_deadline(self.deadline)
            if self.decoder.eof:
                require(not self.pending and not read_checked(self.stream,1,self.deadline),'gzip trailing data')
                require(self.compressed==self.spec.payload_bytes and self.digest.hexdigest()==self.spec.payload_sha256,'payload SHA or compressed length')
                self.finished=True
            else:
                require(data or len(self.pending)<previous,'deflate made no progress')
        output=bytes(self.buffer[:size]); del self.buffer[:size]
        check_deadline(self.deadline)
        return output

def exact(reader,size):
    out=bytearray()
    while len(out)<size:
        part=reader.read(min(CHUNK,size-len(out)))
        require(part,'truncated tar record')
        out.extend(part)
    return bytes(out)

def padding(reader,size):
    count=(-size)%512
    if count:require(not any(exact(reader,count)),'nonzero tar member padding')

def parse_pax(raw):
    result={}; cursor=0
    while cursor<len(raw):
        space=raw.find(b' ',cursor)
        require(space>cursor and re.fullmatch(rb'[1-9][0-9]{0,5}',raw[cursor:space]),'PAX length syntax')
        length=int(raw[cursor:space]); end=cursor+length
        require(space+1<end<=len(raw) and raw[end-1:end]==b'\n','PAX record length')
        pair=raw[space+1:end-1]
        require(b'=' in pair,'PAX key-value syntax')
        key,value=pair.split(b'=',1)
        require(key in (b'path',b'linkpath',b'size',b'mtime') and key.decode('ascii') not in result,'PAX key unsupported or duplicate')
        try:result[key.decode('ascii')]=value.decode('utf-8')
        except UnicodeError:raise InspectionError('PAX UTF-8 encoding') from None
        cursor=end
    return result

def binary_header(name,prefix,size):
    if name=='candidate/OfficePdfKernel.framework/OfficePdfKernel':
        require(prefix[:8]==b'!<arch>\n','framework archive magic')
        return {'path':name,'container':'ar','containerMagicVerified':True,'memberCount':None,

        require(len(prefix)>=32 and prefix[:4] in (b'\xcf\xfa\xed\xfe',b'\xfe\xed\xfa\xcf'),'probe Mach-O64 magic')
        endian='<' if prefix[:4]==b'\xcf\xfa\xed\xfe' else '>'
        fields=struct.unpack(endian+'8I',prefix[:32])
        require(32+fields[5]<=size,'probe load command size bound')
        return {'path':name,'container':'Mach-O64','cpuType':fields[1],'cpuSubtype':fields[2],
                'architecture':'arm64' if fields[1]==0x0100000c else 'other',
                'fileType':fields[3],'loadCommands':fields[4],'loadCommandBytes':fields[5],
                'boundary':'只读固定头部；未执行probe或检查私有消费者。'}
    if name.endswith('/ICU.dat') or name.endswith('/icudt78l.dat'):
        require(len(prefix)>=20 and prefix[2:4]==b'\xda\x27','ICU data header magic')
        return {'path':name,'magicHex':prefix[2:4].hex(),'isBigEndian':prefix[8],
                'charsetFamily':prefix[9],'sizeofUChar':prefix[10],
                'dataFormatHex':prefix[12:16].hex(),'formatVersionBytes':list(prefix[16:20]),
                'boundary':'头部观察与已核全文件SHA绑定，资源启动未执行。'}
    return None

def scan_tar(stream,spec,expected,deadline,output=None):
    reader=SingleGzipReader(stream,spec,deadline)
    entries=[]; aliases=set(); seen_files=set(); expanded=0; pax=None; pax_count=0; headers=[]
    while True:
        block=exact(reader,512)
        if not any(block):
            require(pax is None and not any(exact(reader,512)),'tar missing second end block or pending PAX')
            tail=1024
            while True:
                data=reader.read(CHUNK)
                if not data:break
                require(not any(data),'hidden data after tar end')
                tail+=len(data)
            require(tail%512==0 and reader.finished,'tar final padding or gzip end')
            break
        try:item=tarfile.TarInfo.frombuf(block,encoding='utf-8',errors='strict')
        except (tarfile.HeaderError,UnicodeError,ValueError):raise InspectionError('invalid tar header checksum or encoding') from None
        require(item is not None and type(item.size) is int and item.size>=0 and not item.mode & ~0o777,'tar header size or special permissions')
        if item.type==tarfile.XHDTYPE:
            require(pax is None and item.name=='././@PaxHeader' and 0<item.size<=65536,'PAX metadata boundary')
            pax_count+=1; require(pax_count<=spec.expected_members,'PAX metadata record count')
            pax=parse_pax(exact(reader,item.size));padding(reader,item.size)
            continue
        require(item.type in (tarfile.REGTYPE,tarfile.AREGTYPE,tarfile.DIRTYPE),'tar hardlink special or unsupported type')
        metadata=pax or {};pax=None
        name=clean_name(metadata.get('path',item.name))
        require(alias(name) not in aliases and len(entries)<spec.expected_members,'archive duplicate alias or member bound')
        aliases.add(alias(name))
        size=item.size
        if 'size' in metadata:
            require(re.fullmatch('[0-9]{1,12}',metadata['size']) is not None,'PAX size syntax')
            size=int(metadata['size'])
        stamp=metadata.get('mtime',str(item.mtime));ns=mtime_ns(stamp)
        row={'path':name,'mode':item.mode,'mtimeText':stamp,'mtimeNs':ns,'bytes':size}
        if item.type in (tarfile.REGTYPE,tarfile.AREGTYPE):
            require(name not in seen_files and size <= spec.expanded_bytes, 'duplicate regular or file size bound')
            if expected is not None:
                require(name in expected and size == expected[name]['bytes'], 'unlisted regular file or size')
            seen_files.add(name);expanded+=size
            require(expanded<=spec.expanded_bytes,'expanded regular bytes bound')
            digest=hashlib.sha256();remaining=size;prefix=bytearray()
            target=output/name if output is not None else None
            if target is not None:safe_components(target,must_exist=False)
            with target.open('xb') if target is not None else nullcontext() as sink:
                while remaining:
                    data=exact(reader,min(CHUNK,remaining));remaining-=len(data)
                    check_deadline(deadline);digest.update(data)
                    if len(prefix)<64:prefix.extend(data[:64-len(prefix)])
                    if sink is not None:
                        require(sink.write(data)==len(data),'short extraction write');check_deadline(deadline)
                if sink is not None:sink.flush();os.fsync(sink.fileno());check_deadline(deadline)
            if expected is not None:
                require(digest.hexdigest() == expected[name]['sha256'], 'regular file SHA mismatch')
            row.update(type='regular',sha256=digest.hexdigest())
            if spec.production:
                observation=binary_header(name,bytes(prefix),size)
                if observation:headers.append(observation)
        elif item.type==tarfile.DIRTYPE:
            require(size == 0 and (expected is None or name not in expected), 'directory size or regular inventory collision')
            row['type']='directory'
        padding(reader,size);entries.append(row)
    require(len(entries) == spec.expected_members and len(seen_files) == spec.expected_files and expanded == spec.expanded_bytes, 'exact member file or expanded total')
    if expected is not None:
        require(seen_files == set(expected), 'exact expected file set')
    validate_graph(entries);check_deadline(deadline)
    return {'entries':entries,'members':len(entries),'regularFiles':len(seen_files),'expandedRegularBytes':expanded,
        'tarBytes':reader.expanded,'gzipBytes':reader.compressed,'payloadSha256':reader.digest.hexdigest(),
        'directories':[row for row in entries if row['type']=='directory'],
        'symlinks':[row for row in entries if row['type']=='symlink'],'binaryHeaderObservations':headers,
        'singleGzipMemberCrcIsizeAndNoTailVerified':True,'allExpectedRegularFilesVerified':True,'extracted':False}

def validate_graph(entries):
    by_name = {row['path']: row for row in entries}
    require('candidate' in by_name and by_name['candidate']['type'] == 'directory', 'tar root missing')
    for row in entries:
        require(row['type'] in ('regular', 'directory'), 'links are forbidden')
        for parent in PurePosixPath(row['path']).parents:
            if parent.as_posix() != '.':
                require(parent.as_posix() in by_name and by_name[parent.as_posix()]['type'] == 'directory',
                        'missing or non-directory archive ancestor')

def canonical_bytes(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8')

def canonical_inventory(entries):
    # pathlib.rglob 原生成器采用组件次序；整路径 str 排序会把 a.txt 放到 a/z 前面。
    rows = [{'path': row['path'][len('candidate/'):], 'bytes': row['bytes'], 'sha256': row['sha256']}
            for row in entries if row['type'] == 'regular']
    rows.sort(key=lambda row: PurePosixPath(row['path']).parts)
    return {'files': rows, 'totalBytes': sum(row['bytes'] for row in rows), 'available': False}

def verify_inventory(entries, spec=PRODUCTION):
    value = canonical_inventory(entries)
    raw = canonical_bytes(value)
    require(len(value['files']) == spec.expected_files and value['totalBytes'] == spec.expanded_bytes and
            len(raw) == spec.inventory_bytes and sha(raw) == spec.inventory_sha256, 'original inventory identity')
    if spec.production:
        rows = {r['path']: r for r in value['files']}
        for name, (size, digest) in CRITICAL.items():
            require(name in rows and rows[name]['bytes'] == size and rows[name]['sha256'] == digest,
                    'critical candidate identity')
    return value


def write_json(path, value):
    raw = canonical_bytes(value)
    require(len(raw) <= LOG_FILE_BYTES, 'JSON evidence size bound')
    with path.open('xb') as stream:
        require(stream.write(raw) == len(raw), 'short JSON write')


def hash_file(path, size, deadline):
    with pinned_regular(path, size) as (stream, identity):
        value = hashlib.sha256()
        while True:
            raw = read_checked(stream, CHUNK, deadline)
            if not raw:
                break
            value.update(raw)
        return value.hexdigest(), identity


def new_directory(path):
    path = Path(path).absolute()
    safe_components(path.parent)
    require(not os.path.lexists(path), 'refuse existing output directory')
    path.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    return path


def verify_extracted(output, inventory, entries, deadline, *, trusted_filesystem=None):
    by_name = {row['path']: row for row in entries}
    if trusted_filesystem is not None:
        require(isinstance(trusted_filesystem, dict) and
                set(trusted_filesystem) == {row['path'] for row in inventory['files']},
                'trusted filesystem exact file path set')
        fields = {'device', 'inode', 'mode', 'links', 'bytes', 'mtimeNs', 'ctimeNs'}
        require(all(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == fields and
                    all(type(item) is int for item in value.values())
                    for value in trusted_filesystem.values()), 'trusted filesystem complete identity schema')
    observations = []
    for row in inventory['files']:
        name = 'candidate/' + row['path']
        digest, identity = hash_file(output / name, row['bytes'], deadline)
        require(digest == row['sha256'], 'post-extraction SHA mismatch')
        if trusted_filesystem is not None:
            require(identity == trusted_filesystem[row['path']], 'trusted candidate filesystem identity changed')
        observations.append({'path': row['path'], 'archiveMtimeNs': by_name[name]['mtimeNs'],
            'filesystemMtimeNs': identity['mtimeNs'], 'archiveMode': by_name[name]['mode'],
            'filesystemMode': identity['mode'] & 0o777,
            'filesystemIdentity': dict(identity),
            'mtimeExactlyPreserved': identity['mtimeNs'] == by_name[name]['mtimeNs']})
    actual = set()
    for path in output.rglob('*'):
        safe_components(path)
        require(path.is_file() or path.is_dir(), 'unexpected extracted type')
        actual.add(path.relative_to(output).as_posix())
    require(actual == set(by_name), 'post-extraction exact path set')
    return {'verifiedFiles': len(observations),
            'mtimeMismatchCount': sum(not r['mtimeExactlyPreserved'] for r in observations),
            'archiveVsFilesystemTimes': observations,
            'trustedFilesystemIdentityCompared': trusted_filesystem is not None,
            'filesystemIdentityBoundary': '实际dev/inode/完整mode/nlink/size/mtimeNs/ctimeNs全部守恒；读取atime不在原STAT_FIELDS内。',
            'mtimeBoundary': '归档PAX为精确整数纳秒；文件系统值为提取后实际读取，未假定跨平台精度。'}


def restore_candidate(checkpoint, work, deadline, *, spec=PRODUCTION):
    checkpoint = safe_components(checkpoint)
    require(checkpoint.is_dir() and {p.name for p in checkpoint.iterdir()} == {'payload.tar.gz', 'manifest.json'},
            'exact fixed two-file wrapper')
    require(not work.exists() and work.parent.is_dir() and not work.is_relative_to(checkpoint), 'new owned work root')
    manifest_raw, manifest_identity = small_pinned(checkpoint / 'manifest.json', spec.manifest_bytes,
                                                  spec.manifest_sha256, deadline)
    manifest = validate_manifest(manifest_raw, spec)
    with pinned_regular(checkpoint / 'payload.tar.gz', spec.payload_bytes) as (stream, payload_identity):
        # 第一遍不信任BUILD的自报清单：真读并哈希全部成员，然后绑定已审原inventory SHA。
        first = scan_tar(stream, spec, None, deadline)
        require(not first['symlinks'], 'candidate links forbidden')
        inventory = verify_inventory(first['entries'], spec)
        expected = {'candidate/' + row['path']: row for row in inventory['files']}
        new_directory(work)
        restored = new_directory(work / 'restored')
        for row in sorted(first['directories'], key=lambda item: (item['path'].count('/'), item['path'])):
            target = restored / row['path']
            safe_components(target, must_exist=False)
            target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        stream.seek(0)
        second = scan_tar(stream, spec, expected, deadline, output=restored)
        require(first['entries'] == second['entries'], 'tar metadata changed between audit and extraction')
        # macOS能安全通过不跟随链接的utime恢复ns；不支持的平台保留实际精度边界。
        timestamp_restored = os.utime in os.supports_follow_symlinks
        if timestamp_restored:
            for row in sorted(first['entries'], key=lambda item: item['path'].count('/'), reverse=True):
                target = safe_components(restored / row['path'])
                os.utime(target, ns=(row['mtimeNs'], row['mtimeNs']), follow_symlinks=False)
        extraction = verify_extracted(restored, inventory, first['entries'], deadline)
    require(small_pinned(checkpoint / 'manifest.json', spec.manifest_bytes, spec.manifest_sha256, deadline)[0]
            == manifest_raw, 'manifest changed after extraction')
    require(verify_inventory(second['entries'], spec) == inventory, 'second inventory mismatch')
    candidate = restored / 'candidate'
    if spec.production:
        verify_candidate_metadata(candidate, inventory, deadline)
    return candidate, inventory, manifest, {
        'producer': PRODUCER, 'cacheKey': spec.cache_key, 'payloadIdentity': payload_identity,
        'manifestIdentity': manifest_identity, 'payloadSha256': spec.payload_sha256,
        'manifestSha256': spec.manifest_sha256, 'inventorySha256': spec.inventory_sha256,
        'members': second['members'], 'files': len(inventory['files']),
        'expandedBytes': inventory['totalBytes'], 'directories': len(first['directories']),
        'archiveEntries': first['entries'],
        'singleGzipCrcIsizeAndNoTailVerified': True, 'allMemberHashesVerified': True,
        'postExtraction': extraction, 'archiveMtimeRestoreAttempted': timestamp_restored,
        'trustedFilesystemIdentityCaptured': True, 'producerWrapperStableThroughRestore': True,
        'sourceCandidateUnchangedAcrossLinkPending': True, 'binaryExecuted': False}


def candidate_small(candidate, inventory, name, deadline):
    rows = {row['path']: row for row in inventory['files']}
    require(name in rows and rows[name]['bytes'] <= 8 * 1024**2, 'small candidate metadata bound')
    return small_pinned(candidate / name, rows[name]['bytes'], rows[name]['sha256'], deadline)[0]


def verify_candidate_metadata(candidate, inventory, deadline):
    raw = candidate_small(candidate, inventory, 'BUILD.json', deadline)
    build = strict_json(raw)
    require(isinstance(build, dict) and build.get('architecture') == 'arm64' and build.get('platform') == 'iOS'
            and build.get('minimumIOS') == '14.5' and build.get('acceptanceOnly') is True
            and build.get('appleLinkVerified') is True and build.get('deviceRuntimeVerified') is False
            and build.get('strictOffline') is False and build.get('available') is False
            and build.get('systemLibraries') == list(SYSTEM_LIBRARIES), 'producer BUILD qualification boundary')
    require(build.get('sourceCommit') == '8221e31b3ac356a1623c672912a3d2b492f7e3d1'
            and build.get('sourceTag') == 'libreoffice-26.2.6.3', 'upstream source binding')
    require(isinstance(build.get('artifacts'), list), 'BUILD artifact list')
    expected = inventory['files']
    reconstructed = [*build['artifacts'], {'path': 'BUILD.json', 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw)}]
    require(all(isinstance(row, dict) and set(row) == {'path', 'bytes', 'sha256'} for row in reconstructed),
            'BUILD artifact row schema')
    reconstructed.sort(key=lambda row: PurePosixPath(row['path']).parts)
    require(reconstructed == expected and sha(canonical_bytes({'files': reconstructed,
            'totalBytes': sum(row['bytes'] for row in reconstructed), 'available': False}))
            == PRODUCTION.inventory_sha256, 'BUILD plus self must reconstruct original inventory')
    manifest_name = 'OfficePdfKernelResources.bundle/OfficePdfKernelManifest.json'
    resources = strict_json(candidate_small(candidate, inventory, manifest_name, deadline))
    require(isinstance(resources, dict) and resources.get('sourceCommit') == build['sourceCommit']
            and resources.get('sourceTag') == build['sourceTag'] and resources.get('offlinePolicy') == build['offlinePolicy']
            and resources.get('buildCompatibility') == build['buildCompatibility']
            and resources.get('resources') == build['resources'], 'resource Manifest binding')
    actual_resources = [{'path': r['path'][len('OfficePdfKernelResources.bundle/'):],
                         'bytes': r['bytes'], 'sha256': r['sha256']} for r in inventory['files']
                        if r['path'].startswith('OfficePdfKernelResources.bundle/') and r['path'] != manifest_name]
    require(actual_resources == resources['resources'] and len(actual_resources) == 2400,
            'complete actual resource file set')
    return build


def consumer_identity(env, source_manifest_sha):
    commit, run, attempt, job = (env.get(name, '') for name in
        ('GITHUB_SHA', 'GITHUB_RUN_ID', 'GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT', 'GITHUB_JOB'))
    require(re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{40}', commit) and re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]*', run)
            and re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]*', attempt) and re.fullmatch('[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,99}', job),
            'real consumer commit run attempt job required')
    require(re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{64}', source_manifest_sha), 'consumer source manifest SHA')
    require(commit != PRODUCER['GITHUB_SHA'] and run != PRODUCER['GITHUB_RUN_ID'], 'producer and consumer must differ')
    return {'sourceCommit': commit, 'runId': run, 'runAttempt': attempt, 'jobName': job,
            'sourceManifestSha256': source_manifest_sha}

def apple_commands(source, candidate, obj, executable, sdk):
    common = ['xcrun', '--sdk', 'iphoneos', 'swiftc', '-target', 'arm64-apple-ios14.5', '-sdk', sdk]
    compile_args = [*common, '-Onone', '-parse-as-library', '-module-name', 'OfficePdfKernelAcceptance',
                    '-F', str(candidate), '-emit-object', str(source), '-o', str(obj)]
    link_args = [*common, '-emit-executable', str(obj), '-F', str(candidate),
                '-Xlinker', '-force_load', '-Xlinker', str(candidate / 'OfficePdfKernel.framework/OfficePdfKernel'),
                *['-l' + name for name in SYSTEM_LIBRARIES]]

def inspect_macho(raw, total_size):
    require(len(raw) >= 32 and raw[:4] == b'\xcf\xfa\xed\xfe', 'Apple consumer Mach-O64 little-endian')
    header = struct.unpack('<8I', raw[:32])
    require(header[1] == 0x100000c and header[3] == 2 and 0 < header[4] <= 256
            and 32 + header[5] <= min(total_size, len(raw)), 'arm64 executable header bounds')
    cursor = 32
    versions = []
    signature = False
    for _ in range(header[4]):
        require(cursor + 8 <= 32 + header[5], 'load command header bounds')
        cmd, size = struct.unpack('<2I', raw[cursor:cursor + 8])
        require(size >= 8 and size % 4 == 0 and cursor + size <= 32 + header[5], 'load command size')
        if cmd == 0x32:
            require(size >= 24, 'LC_BUILD_VERSION size')
            platform_id, minos, sdk, tools = struct.unpack('<4I', raw[cursor + 8:cursor + 24])
            require(platform_id == 2 and (minos >> 16, minos >> 8 & 255, minos & 255) == (14, 5, 0)
                    and 24 + tools * 8 == size, 'iPhoneOS exact minimum14.5')
            versions.append((minos, sdk))
        signature |= cmd == 0x1d
        cursor += size
    require(cursor == 32 + header[5] and len(versions) == 1, 'single complete iOS version command')
    minos, sdk = versions[0]
    version = lambda n: f'{n >> 16}.{n >> 8 & 255}.{n & 255}'
    return {'architecture': 'arm64', 'platform': 'IOS', 'minimumIOS': version(minos), 'sdk': version(sdk),
            'codeSignatureLoadCommandPresent': signature,
            'signingBoundary': '未调用codesign或使用证书；链接器可能生成adhoc签名，未声称无LC_CODE_SIGNATURE。',
            'binaryExecuted': False}

def validate_notices(raw):
    require(len(raw) <= 4 * 1024**2, 'notices source size bound')
    value = strict_json(raw)
    fields = {'format', 'producer', 'scope', 'redistributionApproved', 'qualificationGaps', 'files'}
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == fields and value['format'] == 'office-pdf-ios-harness-notices-v1'
            and value['scope'] == 'internal-unsigned-acceptance-only' and value['redistributionApproved'] is False,
            'notices qualification schema')
    require(isinstance(value['producer'], dict) and type(value['producer'].get('attempt')) is int
            and value['producer'] == {'repository': 'lizhaoxrj/lizhao-office-pdf-ios-kernel',
            'run': PRODUCER['GITHUB_RUN_ID'], 'attempt': 1, 'sourceCommit': PRODUCER['GITHUB_SHA']}, 'notices producer binding')
    require(isinstance(value['qualificationGaps'], list) and len(value['qualificationGaps']) == 6
            and all(isinstance(row, dict) and set(row) == {'id', 'scope', 'evidence', 'next'}
                    and all(isinstance(v, str) and v for v in row.values()) for row in value['qualificationGaps']),
            'six explicit redistribution qualification gaps')
    require(len({row['id'] for row in value['qualificationGaps']}) == 6, 'unique qualification gap identities')
    require(isinstance(value['files'], list) and len(value['files']) == 109, 'complete approved notices material count')
    result, seen, total = [], set(), 0
    row_fields = {'path', 'bytes', 'sha256', 'contentBase64', 'sourceUrl', 'sourceVersion',
                  'publicDerived', 'originalBytes', 'originalSha256', 'removedLocalPaths'}
    for row in value['files']:
        require(isinstance(row, dict) and set(row) == row_fields, 'notices file schema')
        name = row['path']
        require(isinstance(name, str), 'notices path type')
        clean_name('candidate/' + name)
        require(name.split('/')[0] in ('LICENSES', 'NOTICES', 'SOURCES') and '/' in name and alias(name) not in seen,
                'notices path root or duplicate alias')
        seen.add(alias(name))
        require(type(row['bytes']) is int and 0 < row['bytes'] <= 4 * 1024**2
                and isinstance(row['contentBase64'], str) and len(row['contentBase64']) <= 6 * 1024**2,
                'notices encoded byte bound')
        try:
            body = base64.b64decode(row['contentBase64'], validate=True)
        except (ValueError, binascii.Error):
            raise InspectionError('notices base64 invalid') from None
        require(base64.b64encode(body).decode('ascii') == row['contentBase64'] and len(body) == row['bytes']
                and sha(body) == row['sha256'], 'notices canonical base64 byte identity')
        require(type(row['publicDerived']) is bool and type(row['originalBytes']) is int and row['originalBytes'] > 0
                and re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{64}', row['originalSha256'])
                and type(row['removedLocalPaths']) is int and row['removedLocalPaths'] >= 0, 'notices provenance types')
        if not row['publicDerived']:
            require(row['originalBytes'] == row['bytes'] and row['originalSha256'] == row['sha256']
                    and row['removedLocalPaths'] == 0, 'unaltered original notices identity')
        require(isinstance(row['sourceVersion'], str) and bool(row['sourceVersion'])
                and isinstance(row['sourceUrl'], str) and (row['sourceUrl'] == 'unknown'
                or re.fullmatch(r'https://[^\s@?#]+(?:\?format=(?:TEXT|JSON))?', row['sourceUrl'])), 'public notices source reference')
        total += len(body)
        require(total <= 8 * 1024**2, 'notices total decoded byte bound')
        result.append((row, body))
    require(sum(not row['publicDerived'] for row, _ in result) == 107
            and sum(row['publicDerived'] for row, _ in result) == 2, 'original and derived notices distinction')
    return value, result


def copy_verified(source, target, row, deadline):
    safe_components(target, must_exist=False)
    with pinned_regular(source, row['bytes']) as (stream, identity), target.open('xb') as sink:
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        count = 0
        while True:
            raw = read_checked(stream, CHUNK, deadline)
            if not raw:
                break
            count += len(raw)
            require(count <= row['bytes'] and sink.write(raw) == len(raw), 'resource copy byte bound')
            digest.update(raw)
        sink.flush()
        os.fsync(sink.fileno())
        require(count == row['bytes'] and digest.hexdigest() == row['sha256'], 'resource source byte identity')
    require(hash_file(target, row['bytes'], deadline)[0] == row['sha256'], 'staged resource byte identity')

def load_ci_runner():
    # 复用生产Runner的编号/证据初始化；以下适配补齐非零/中断路径的组收束与实时日志上界。
    directory = ROOT / 'ci'
    previous = list(sys.path)
    try:
        sys.path.insert(0, str(directory))
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('office_pdf_harness_ci_driver', directory / 'run.py')
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        return module.Runner
    finally:
        sys.path[:] = previous


class HarnessRunner:
    def __init__(self, evidence, deadline):
        self.base = load_ci_runner()(evidence)
        self.base.deadline = deadline
        self.groups = set()
        self.commands = []

    @staticmethod
    def group_alive(pid):
        try:
            os.killpg(pid, 0)
        except ProcessLookupError:
            return False
        return True

    def stop_group(self, process):
        # 自有start_new_session组，无全局kill；任何清理异常由调用方作为次错记录。
        try:
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass
        process.wait(timeout=5)
        until = time.monotonic() + 3
        while self.group_alive(process.pid) and time.monotonic() < until:
            time.sleep(0.02)
        require(not self.group_alive(process.pid), 'command process group remains active')
        self.groups.discard(process.pid)

    def run(self, args, cwd=None, env=None):
        require(sys.platform == 'darwin', 'real Apple command runner requires macOS')
        require(self.base.deadline - time.monotonic() >= 60, 'harness command time reserve exhausted')
        self.base.index += 1
        require(self.base.index <= 99, 'NN command count bound')
        label = f'{self.base.index:02d}'
        output = self.base.evidence / (label + '-output.log')
        write_json(self.base.evidence / (label + '-command.json'),
                   {'argv': [str(a) for a in args], 'cwd': str(cwd) if cwd else None})
        print('命令 ' + label + ' 开始', flush=True)
        started, process, primary, secondary, exit_code = time.monotonic(), None, None, [], None
        try:
            with output.open('xb') as log:
                process = subprocess.Popen([str(a) for a in args], cwd=cwd, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                           stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
                self.groups.add(process.pid)
                while True:
                    require(output.stat().st_size <= LOG_FILE_BYTES, 'command log32MiB bound exceeded')
                    require(time.monotonic() < self.base.deadline - 30, 'harness command deadline exceeded')
                    exit_code = process.poll()
                    if exit_code is not None:
                        break
                    time.sleep(0.05)
                require(exit_code == 0, f'command {label} returned nonzero {exit_code}')
                require(not self.group_alive(process.pid), 'successful command left active children')
                self.groups.discard(process.pid)
                log.flush()
            require(output.stat().st_size <= LOG_FILE_BYTES, 'final command log32MiB bound exceeded')
            print('命令 ' + label + ' 完成', flush=True)
        except BaseException as error:
            primary = error
            raise
        finally:
            if process is not None and process.pid in self.groups:
                try:
                    self.stop_group(process)
                except BaseException as error:
                    secondary.append(type(error).__name__)
            record = {'label': label, 'exitCode': exit_code, 'elapsedSeconds': time.monotonic() - started,
                      'primaryErrorType': type(primary).__name__ if primary else None,
                      'cleanupErrorTypes': secondary, 'processGroupQuiescent': not self.groups}
            self.commands.append(record)
            if secondary:
                if primary is not None:
                    primary.harness_cleanup_secondary = secondary
                else:
                    raise InspectionError('command cleanup failed')
        return output

    def require_quiescent(self):
        require(not self.groups, 'refuse archive with active or unknown command group')


def command_text(runner, args):
    path = runner.run(args, cwd=ROOT)
    size = path.stat().st_size
    require(size <= LOG_FILE_BYTES, 'text command output bound')
    with pinned_regular(path, size) as (stream, _):
        raw = read_checked(stream, size + 1, runner.base.deadline)
    try:
        return raw.decode('utf-8').strip()
    except UnicodeError:
        raise InspectionError('Apple tool output is not UTF-8') from None


def collect_toolchain(runner, producer_manifest):
    require(sys.platform == 'darwin' and platform.machine() == 'x86_64', 'standard Intel macOS consumer required')
    commands = {'xcode': ['xcodebuild', '-version'],
                'iphoneosSDK': ['xcrun', '--sdk', 'iphoneos', '--show-sdk-path'],
                'clangVersion': ['xcrun', '--sdk', 'iphoneos', 'clang++', '--version'],
                'swiftVersion': ['xcrun', '--sdk', 'iphoneos', 'swiftc', '--version']}
    current = {name: command_text(runner, args) for name, args in commands.items()}
    producer = producer_manifest['identity']
    require(producer['architecture'] == 'x86_64' and current['xcode'] == producer['tools']['xcode']
            and current['iphoneosSDK'] == producer['tools']['iphoneosSDK']
            and current['clangVersion'] == producer['versions']['clangVersion'], 'exact producer Apple toolchain binding')
    require(Path(current['iphoneosSDK']).is_dir(), 'real iPhoneOS SDK directory')
    return {'producerToolchainMatched': True, 'consumerTools': current,
            'consumerRunnerImage': os.environ.get('ImageVersion', 'unknown'),
            'producerRunnerImage': producer['runnerImage'], 'architecture': platform.machine(),
            'sourceBinaryRebuilt': False}


def validate_evidence(directory, deadline=None):
    rows, total, log_total = [], 0, 0
    for path in sorted(directory.iterdir()):
        check_deadline(deadline)
        safe_components(path)
        info = path.lstat()
        require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1 and
                (path.name in RECORD_NAMES or LOG_NAME.fullmatch(path.name)), 'evidence JSON/log whitelist')
        require(info.st_size <= LOG_FILE_BYTES, 'evidence file32MiB bound')
        total += info.st_size
        if path.suffix == '.log':
            log_total += info.st_size
        require(total <= LOG_TOTAL_BYTES - LOG_METADATA_RESERVE and
                log_total <= LOG_TOTAL_BYTES - LOG_METADATA_RESERVE, 'evidence total budget with metadata reserve')
        digest, identity = hash_file(path, info.st_size, deadline)
        rows.append({'path': path.name, 'bytes': info.st_size, 'sha256': digest})
    return rows


def seal_evidence(evidence, runner, deadline=None):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 120 if deadline is None else deadline
    check_deadline(deadline)
    runner.require_quiescent()
    raw = evidence / 'raw'
    rows = validate_evidence(raw, deadline)
    require(any(row['path'] == 'HARNESS-RESULT.json' for row in rows), 'actual result required before seal')
    upload = new_directory(evidence / 'upload')
    for row in rows:
        copy_verified(raw / row['path'], upload / row['path'], row, deadline)
    require(validate_evidence(upload, deadline) == rows, 'complete copied evidence rehash')
    runner.require_quiescent()
    # 最后创建标记，复制失败不会留下可上传的假success封印。
    value = {'format': 'office-pdf-ios-abi-harness-evidence-v1', 'files': rows,
             'totalOriginalBytes': sum(row['bytes'] for row in rows), 'allProcessGroupsQuiescent': True,
             'onlyJsonAndLogs': True, 'binaryArtifactExported': False}
    sealed = canonical_bytes(value)
    require(len(sealed) <= LOG_METADATA_RESERVE and value['totalOriginalBytes'] + len(sealed) <= LOG_TOTAL_BYTES,
            'seal metadata or complete128MiB budget')
    pending = evidence / 'SEAL-PENDING.json'
    with pending.open('xb') as stream:
        require(stream.write(sealed) == len(sealed), 'short evidence seal write')
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    require(hash_file(pending, len(sealed), deadline)[0] == sha(sealed), 'pending seal identity')
    require(not os.path.lexists(upload / 'SEALED.json'), 'refuse existing evidence seal')
    pending.rename(upload / 'SEALED.json')
    return value


def stage_inventory(app, deadline):
    rows = []
    for path in sorted(app.rglob('*'), key=lambda p: p.relative_to(app).parts):
        safe_components(path)
        if path.is_dir():
            continue
        info = path.lstat()
        digest, identity = hash_file(path, info.st_size, deadline)
        rows.append({'path': path.relative_to(app).as_posix(), 'bytes': info.st_size, 'sha256': digest})
    return {'files': rows, 'totalBytes': sum(row['bytes'] for row in rows),
            'binaryExecuted': False, 'redistributionApproved': False, 'installationQualified': False}


def compile_harness(runner, candidate, app, toolchain, deadline):
    obj, executable = candidate.parents[1] / 'consumer.o', app / 'OfficePdfKernelAcceptance'
    args = apple_commands(ROOT / 'acceptance/KernelAbiAcceptance.swift', candidate, obj, executable,
                          toolchain['consumerTools']['iphoneosSDK'])
    runner.run(args[0], cwd=ROOT)
    undefined = command_text(runner, ['xcrun', '--sdk', 'iphoneos', 'nm', '-u', '-j', str(obj)])
    verify_symbols(undefined, undefined=True)
    runner.run(args[1], cwd=ROOT)
    definitions = command_text(runner, ['xcrun', '--sdk', 'iphoneos', 'nm', '-gU', '-j', str(executable)])
    verify_symbols(definitions, undefined=False)
    vtool = command_text(runner, ['xcrun', 'vtool', '-show-build', str(executable)])
    require(re.search(r'\bplatform\s+IOS\b', vtool) and re.search(r'\bminos\s+14\.5(?:\.0)?\b', vtool),
            'real vtool iPhoneOS min14.5 result')
    info = executable.lstat()
    with pinned_regular(executable, info.st_size) as (stream, _):
        header = read_checked(stream, 1024 * 1024, deadline)
    macho = inspect_macho(header, info.st_size)
    runner.require_quiescent()
    return {'fourCReferencesVerifiedInSwiftObject': True, 'fourCDefinitionsVerifiedInLinkedConsumer': True,
            'object': {'bytes': obj.stat().st_size, 'sha256': hash_file(obj, obj.stat().st_size, deadline)[0]},
            'executable': {'bytes': info.st_size, 'sha256': hash_file(executable, info.st_size, deadline)[0]},
            'macho': macho, 'vtool': vtool, 'forceLoadPreserved': True, 'binaryExecuted': False,
            'privateSwiftCompileVerified': False, 'deviceRuntimeVerified': False}

    parser.add_argument('--work', type=Path, required=True)

    overall_deadline = time.monotonic() + HARNESS_SECONDS
    deadline = overall_deadline - 120  # 在20min整体预算内为失败日志封存预留两分钟。
    runner, evidence, raw, primary = None, None, None, None
    result = {'format': 'office-pdf-ios-abi-harness-result-v1', 'success': False,
              'producer': PRODUCER, 'productionAvailable': False, 'strictOfflineQualified': False,
              'publicAbiHarnessVerified': False, 'pluginIntegrated': False,
              'sourceCandidateUnchanged': False,
              'candidateFilesystemIdentityVerifiedBeforeLink': False,
              'candidateFilesystemIdentityVerifiedAfterLink': False,
              'readyForCustomBase': False, 'deviceRuntimeVerified': False, 'binaryExecuted': False}
    try:
        require(sys.platform == 'darwin' and platform.machine() == 'x86_64', 'real free Intel Apple runner required')
        checkpoint = safe_components(args.checkpoint)
        work = Path(args.work).absolute()
        evidence = new_directory(args.evidence)
        require(not evidence.is_relative_to(checkpoint) and not work.is_relative_to(evidence)
                and not evidence.is_relative_to(work), 'independent checkpoint work evidence paths')
        raw = new_directory(evidence / 'raw')
        runner = HarnessRunner(raw, deadline)
        source_path = ROOT.parents[1] / 'kernel-source.json'
        require(source_path.is_file() and source_path.stat().st_size <= 28 * 1024**2, 'current public source manifest')
        source_sha = hash_file(source_path, source_path.stat().st_size, deadline)[0]
        consumer = consumer_identity(os.environ, source_sha)
        result['consumer'] = consumer
        # 测试命令也纳入同一原日志/组收束/预算封存；不在unittest内递归调用main。
        for command in ([sys.executable, '-B', str(ROOT / 'ci/test_sources.py'), '-v'],
                        [sys.executable, '-B', str(ROOT / 'ci/test_run.py'), 'AuditTransportTests', '-v'],
                        [sys.executable, '-B', str(ROOT / 'acceptance/test_build_harness.py'), '-v']):
            runner.run(command, cwd=ROOT)
        candidate, inventory, producer_manifest, restored = restore_candidate(checkpoint, work, deadline)
        # 此基线只取自安全提取和原SHA全审后的第一次真实fs观察；后面不得重采样替换。
        trusted_filesystem = {row['path']: dict(row['filesystemIdentity'])
                              for row in restored['postExtraction']['archiveVsFilesystemTimes']}
        result['candidateFilesystemBaselineSha256'] = sha(canonical_bytes(trusted_filesystem))
        write_json(raw / 'CANDIDATE-RESTORE.json', restored)
        identity = harness_identity(consumer)
        write_json(raw / 'HARNESS-IDENTITY.json', identity)
        app, staging = stage_app(candidate, inventory, work, identity, args.notices, deadline)
        write_json(raw / 'RESOURCE-STAGING.json', staging)
        toolchain = collect_toolchain(runner, producer_manifest)
        write_json(raw / 'APPLE-TOOLCHAIN.json', toolchain)
        before_link_staging = stage_inventory(app, deadline)
        pre_link = verify_extracted(candidate.parent, inventory, restored['archiveEntries'], deadline,
                                    trusted_filesystem=trusted_filesystem)
        require(pre_link['verifiedFiles'] == 2410 and pre_link['trustedFilesystemIdentityCompared'],
                'pre-link trusted candidate identity and hashes')
        result['candidateFilesystemIdentityVerifiedBeforeLink'] = True
        linked = compile_harness(runner, candidate, app, toolchain, deadline)
        final_stage = stage_inventory(app, deadline)
        before_rows = {row['path']: row for row in before_link_staging['files']}
        after_rows = {row['path']: row for row in final_stage['files']}
        require(set(after_rows) == set(before_rows) | {'OfficePdfKernelAcceptance'} and
                all(after_rows[name] == row for name, row in before_rows.items()),
                'all original staged resources fixtures identity notices unchanged after Apple link')
        write_json(raw / 'STAGING-INVENTORY.json', final_stage)
        # 链接后重核原候选全部文件，新的消费者和Notices不能改变已审producer输入。
        post = verify_extracted(candidate.parent, inventory, restored['archiveEntries'], deadline,
                                trusted_filesystem=trusted_filesystem)
        require(post['verifiedFiles'] == 2410 and post['trustedFilesystemIdentityCompared'],
                'post-link trusted candidate identity and hashes')
        result['candidateFilesystemIdentityVerifiedAfterLink'] = True
        runner.require_quiescent()
        result.update(success=True, publicAbiHarnessVerified=True, appleCompileLink=linked,
                      unsignedStagingVerified=True, stagingFileCount=len(final_stage['files']),
                      sourceCandidateUnchanged=True,
                      sourceCandidateUnchangedScope='安全提取后受信实际fs身份与全SHA在staging后、Apple链接前后均守恒；不是归档ns跨文件系统恢复声明。',
                      allProducerFilesRehashedAfterLink=True,
                      limitations=['未执行harness或LO/资源loader。', '未验证私有UTS/Swift联编或回调。',
                                   'Notices仅内部unsigned验收材料，六项外发资格缺口仍保留。',
                                   'App形状staging并非已签名可安装App或自定义基座。'])
    except BaseException as error:
        primary = error
        result.update(errorType=type(error).__name__,
                      error=str(error) if isinstance(error, InspectionError) else '详情见真实NN原命令/日志；未回显未知异常正文')
    finally:
        if raw is not None and runner is not None:
            result['commands'] = runner.commands
            try:
                runner.require_quiescent()
                write_json(raw / 'HARNESS-RESULT.json', result)
                seal_evidence(evidence, runner, overall_deadline)
            except BaseException as error:
                result['success'] = False
                print('证据未封存：' + type(error).__name__, flush=True)
                if primary is None:
                    primary = error
        print(json.dumps({'success': result['success'], 'errorType': type(primary).__name__ if primary else None,
                          'binaryExecuted': False, 'readyForCustomBase': False}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
    return 0 if result['success'] and primary is None else 1

def fixture(extra=None, *, hidden=b'', gzip_tail=b'', member_type=None):
    bodies = {'BUILD.json': b'{}\n', 'a/second.txt': b'public fixture\n', 'a.txt': b'one\n'}
    if extra:
        bodies.update(extra)
    inventory = {'files': [{'path': name, 'bytes': len(body), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()}
                           for name, body in sorted(bodies.items(), key=lambda item: PurePosixPath(item[0]).parts)],
                 'totalBytes': sum(map(len, bodies.values())), 'available': False}
    out = io.BytesIO()
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=out, mode='w', format=tarfile.PAX_FORMAT) as archive:
        for name in ('candidate', 'candidate/a'):
            row = tarfile.TarInfo(name)
            row.type = tarfile.DIRTYPE
            row.mode = 0o755
            archive.addfile(row)
        for name, body in bodies.items():
            row = tarfile.TarInfo('candidate/' + name)
            row.size = len(body)
            row.mode = 0o644
            row.pax_headers = {'mtime': '1792881885.722583030'}
            if member_type is not None and name == 'a.txt':
                row.type = member_type
                row.size = 0
                row.linkname = 'a/second.txt'
                archive.addfile(row)
            else:
                archive.addfile(row, io.BytesIO(body))
    raw = out.getvalue() + hidden
    payload = gzip.compress(raw, mtime=0) + gzip_tail
    candidate_spec = h.Spec(payload_bytes=len(payload), payload_sha256=h.sha(payload),
        manifest_bytes=0, manifest_sha256='', inventory_bytes=len(canonical(inventory)),
        inventory_sha256=h.sha(canonical(inventory)), expected_files=3, expanded_bytes=inventory['totalBytes'],
        expected_members=5, max_tar_bytes=len(raw) + 512, cache_key='fixture', production=False)
    return payload, candidate_spec, inventory

def extraction_fixture(root):
    candidate = root / 'candidate'
    candidate.mkdir()
    body = b'unchanged public candidate bytes\n'
    path = candidate / 'file.txt'
    path.write_bytes(body)
    inventory = {'files': [{'path': 'file.txt', 'bytes': len(body), 'sha256': h.sha(body)}],
                 'totalBytes': len(body), 'available': False}
    entries = [{'path': 'candidate', 'type': 'directory', 'mode': 0o755, 'mtimeNs': 0},
               {'path': 'candidate/file.txt', 'type': 'regular', 'mode': 0o644,
                'mtimeNs': path.stat().st_mtime_ns}]
    report = h.verify_extracted(root, inventory, entries, time.monotonic() + 5)
    row = report['archiveVsFilesystemTimes'][0]
    # V1没有fs身份返回时，从同一安全读取接口记录真实前像，复现旧逻辑接受变更的行为。
    trusted = {'file.txt': row.get('filesystemIdentity') or h.hash_file(path, len(body), time.monotonic() + 5)[1]}
    return path, inventory, entries, trusted


def trusted_recheck(root, inventory, entries, trusted):
    # 旧接口未提供guard时直接调用旧行为，RED应是同字节变更被接受，不能用TypeError假红。
    options = {'trusted_filesystem': trusted} if 'trusted_filesystem' in inspect.signature(h.verify_extracted).parameters else {}
    return h.verify_extracted(root, inventory, entries, time.monotonic() + 5, **options)

                  '        mpBackend.reset(new AquaSkiaSalGraphicsImpl(*this, maShared));\n'
                  '#endif')]})


def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()


def load_offline():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('office_pdf_compat_offline', ROOT / 'apply_offline_policy.py')
    value = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(value)
    return value


def expected_receipt():
    return {'compatibilityId': 'ios-curl-expat-vcl-v6',
            'sourceTag': 'libreoffice-26.2.6.3', 'sourceCommit': '8221e31b3ac356a1623c672912a3d2b492f7e3d1',
            'path': PATH, 'beforeSha256': BEFORE_SHA, 'afterSha256': AFTER_SHA, 'qualified': False,
            'additionalFiles': [{key: entry[key] for key in ('path', 'beforeSha256', 'afterSha256')}
                                for entry in patches()[1:]]}


def transform(original, path=PATH):
    entry = next(entry for entry in patches() if entry['path'] == path)
    if digest(original) != entry['beforeSha256']:
        raise ValueError('构建兼容原始源码漂移: ' + path)
    changed = original
    replacements = entry['replacements'] if 'replacements' in entry else [(entry['before'], entry['after'])]
    for before_text, after_text in replacements:
        before, after = before_text.encode(), after_text.encode()
        if not before or changed.count(before) != 1:
            raise ValueError('构建兼容锚点不唯一: ' + path)
        changed = changed.replace(before, after, 1)
    if digest(changed) != entry['afterSha256']:
        raise ValueError('构建兼容结果漂移: ' + path)
    return changed


def target_path(source, path=PATH):
    target = source / path
    if target.is_symlink() or target.resolve() != target:
        raise ValueError('构建兼容路径含链接')
    return target


def verify(source):
    expected = expected_receipt()
    for entry in (expected, *expected['additionalFiles']):
        target = target_path(source, entry['path'])
        if not target.is_file() or digest(target.read_bytes()) != entry['afterSha256']:
            raise ValueError('构建兼容已应用源码漂移: ' + entry['path'])
    receipt = source / RECEIPT
    if receipt.is_symlink() or not receipt.is_file() or json.loads(receipt.read_bytes()) != expected:
        raise ValueError('构建兼容缺少匹配回执')
    return expected


def apply_or_verify(source, check=False):
    source = source.resolve(strict=True)
    # 离线驱动验证固定HEAD/tag、全部五源deny与全部受跟踪diff；兼容回执另行绑定。
    load_offline().apply_or_verify(source, check=True)
    prepared = []
    states = set()
    for entry in patches():
        target = target_path(source, entry['path'])
        original = target.read_bytes()
        if digest(original) == entry['afterSha256']:
            states.add('applied')
            prepared.append((target, original, original))
        else:
            states.add('original')
            prepared.append((target, original, transform(original, entry['path'])))
    if len(states) != 1:
        raise ValueError('构建兼容部分应用；拒绝自动覆盖或补齐')
    if states == {'applied'}:
        return verify(source)
    if check:
        raise ValueError('必须先应用构建兼容修复')
    receipt = source / RECEIPT
    if receipt.exists() or receipt.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('原始源码已有构建兼容回执，拒绝覆盖')
    created = False
    written = []
    try:
        for target, original, changed in prepared:
            written.append((target, original))
            target.write_bytes(changed)
        with receipt.open('x', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as stream:
            created = True
            json.dump(expected_receipt(), stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
            stream.write('\n')
    except OSError:
        for target, original in reversed(written):
            target.write_bytes(original)
        if created:
            receipt.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        raise
    return verify(source)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--source', type=pathlib.Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--check', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        print(json.dumps(apply_or_verify(args.source, args.check), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        parser.exit(1, '构建兼容失败: ' + str(error) + '\n')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

# Office PDF iOS 独立 compact 构建候选

本目录是独立 compact-Oz 源码模板。它只准备新的公开内核构建与尺寸回执，不证明候选、IPA、免费额度或真机可用。原两工程的旧 45 源文件、公开仓库根 `kernel-source.json`、`restore-source.py` 及旧 workflow 均需逐字保留。允许公开的仍仅是本内核白名单，不能上传完整插件、私有 V5、真实客户文档、凭据或其他项目。

## 三个独立纯文本出口

在冻结全部 lane 源码后，从新的输出目录运行：

```text
python native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/ci/package_sources.py --output <全新的compact上传目录>
```

只生成三个文件：

- `compact-kernel-source.json`
- `compact-restore-source.py`
- `.github/workflows/office-pdf-ios-compact.yml`

前两项位于公开构建仓库根，新 workflow 保持上述完整路径。`native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/ci/office-pdf-ios.yml` 仅是 compact workflow 模板，不覆盖旧 `.github/workflows/office-pdf-ios.yml`、export、harness 或 size workflow。生成器拒绝已有输出目录，先验证全部源码再新建目录；不生成 ZIP，不发布 Release，不调用旧 producer。

固定格式为 `office-pdf-ios-compact-source-v1`，根为 `native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios`。精确 46 项由 `native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/ci/restore-source.py` 固定：原 39 项公共核心源码，加上两个原样通用测量工具 `native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/size_validation/size_probe.py`、`native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/size_validation/test_size_probe.py`，以及 `native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/ci/compact_profile.py`、`native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/ci/test_compact_profile.py`、`native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/ci/measure_compact.py`、`native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/ci/test_measure_compact.py`、`native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/tests/test_compact_resources.py`。不加入旧 size 恢复器、打包器、源运输测试或 workflow。

每项包含原始 UTF-8 文本、字节数及 SHA-256。单文件最多 4MiB，完整清单最多 28MiB。恢复器写入前验证完整固定清单、格式、重复 JSON 字段、重复及大小写路径、UTF-8、字节数、SHA 与额外字段；拒绝绝对路径、穿越、反斜杠、冒号、NUL、符号链接和已有目标目录。先规范工作根以允许 macOS `/var → /private/var` 系统别名，工作根内链接仍拒绝。没有新依赖。

## 独立 source、work 与身份

六个 job 都实际 checkout 用户选定的新 workflow commit，随后独占创建 `$RUNNER_TEMP/office-pdf-ios-compact-source`，把仓库根新 packet 复制为该目录下的 `kernel-source.json`，再由根新 `compact-restore-source.py` 恢复至该目录。回归和驱动的工作目录都指向这个独立 source 根。`native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/ci/run.py` 的 `ROOT.parents[1]/kernel-source.json` 因而只绑定本轮新 packet，不误读仓库根旧 packet。

构建根固定为 `$RUNNER_TEMP/office-pdf-ios-compact`，缓存根固定为 `$RUNNER_TEMP/office-pdf-compact-checkpoint`。静态 compact profile/module SHA、实际配置 HASH、source packet、run/attempt、workflow commit、固定上游、工具链和绝对工作路径共同进入精确身份；增长中的 trace 计数不混入跨阶段静态相等身份。续阶段验证已准备 profile，禁止重新 configure 混旧对象，禁止 restore prefix 或借旧绿。

## 原构建门禁全部保留

仅 `workflow_dispatch`，默认 `probe`；没有 push、PR 或定时触发。令牌为 `contents: read`，checkout 不保留凭据。只使用标准 `macos-15-intel`，原串行组 `office-pdf-ios-kernel`、`cancel-in-progress: false` 保持；不改 runner、付费限额、仓库可见性、证书或签名。

`probe` job/步骤仍为 10/5 分钟；构建五 job/步骤仍为 350/325 分钟，驱动总预算 315 分钟。至少 45GiB 可用磁盘、7GiB 主机内存、2 CPU；至少 14GiB 才最多 4 个任务，否则最多 3 个，且不超过实际 CPU。非最终 make 预留 30 分钟归档，final 预留 20 分钟资源/包装。超时停止自有进程组，不保存失败检查点，不清理系统软件或自动换更贵机器。

完整相邻顺序为 `tools: cross-toolset` → `vcl: vcl.allbuild` → `sd: sd.allbuild` → `sw: sw.allbuild` → `final: build`。固定官方 `LibreOffice/core` tag `libreoffice-26.2.6.3`、commit `8221e31b3ac356a1623c672912a3d2b492f7e3d1`、arm64/iPhoneOS/min14.5、全部 Office 模块和资源保持。仍应用并核验原离线五源补丁及 `ios-curl-expat-vcl-v6` 兼容回执，不关闭格式、TLS 之外功能或改弱原网络阻断。

仍使用真实 Homebrew GNU Make >=4.2、原 pkgconf 隔离代理和真实退出码透传，保留 Expat arc4random_buf 的 iOS 专属分支、VCL 接口/alpha/Quartz 后端回归、固定原始快照与 Apple 真实编译要求。Mac 中的真实工具缺失必须失败，不能把 Windows skip 视为 Apple 通过。

检查点继续只保存成功的 source/build 固定根，按 run/attempt、工具、源码、上游和相邻阶段核验 payload/manifest SHA；路径、大小写、链接、特殊文件、展开体积、磁盘与新目录恢复规则不变。payload、manifest 加 64MiB 开销合计最多 4GiB。每阶段保存后以同一个精确 key `lookup-only` 查询且 `cache-hit=true`；workflow 只在查询后写 `CACHE-PERSISTENCE.json`，它只证明缓存持久化，不证明构建资格。

原 `force_load`、21 个 `-u`、普通 arm64 MH_OBJECT、九族十规则、强弱/common/lost/NSS-UNO/ICU、完整 `AUDIT.json` 与 link-map 门禁均保留。静态优化描述不替代真实编译 argv、输出普通文件身份、SHA 和关键库 Oz 对象证据。目标编译显式 O0/O1 等低优化例外保留；host BUILD 编译不改；不启用 LTO/bitcode。

## 单 ICU 与 final 尺寸回执

官方输入资源完整保留。新候选仅移除 bundle 根 `ICU.dat` 与 `icudt78l.dat` 两个物理副本，`AppRootResources/ICU.dat` 保留完整原数据。其余每条资源路径和字节守恒；不裁 locale、不子集字体。新 manifest 声明 `single-main-icu`，runtime 独立验证 App 主包 ICU 的路径、普通文件、大小和 SHA，同时校验全部剩余 bundle 资源，旧三副本布局不能冒充此候选。

final 由 `native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/ci/run.py` 的 hook 调用新 `native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/ci/measure_compact.py`，只接受本轮实际 BUILD/AUDIT/完整 candidate 清单。它不调用旧 size main/restore_candidate，不恢复旧 producer。以一次初始全 SHA/7stat 身份测量真实 link-probe、独立 strip 副本、保原 force_load/21-u 的 dead-strip 及其 strip 副本，每组后核对同一初始身份。

`COMPACT-PROFILE.json` 记录静态 profile 与真实编译摘要；`COMPACT-SIZE.json` 记录本轮尺寸诊断。入口退出码 0 仅表示 `measurementComplete`，其 `operationScope=build-and-size-receipt-only`；`variantQualificationPassed` 独立，受控 global 符号不合格仍为 false。工具失败、身份变化、非法 JSON、预算或期限失败必须停止。生产、IPA、免费、设备、私有接入与 ready 字段继续 false；候选参考尺寸小于 85MB 也不等于真实 IPA 严格小于 100000000B。

## 有界证据与适用验证

每个 job 执行本轮 `native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/ci/test_sources.py`、`native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/ci/test_checkpoint.py`、`native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/ci/test_inspect_link.py`、`native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/ci/test_compact_profile.py`、`native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/ci/test_measure_compact.py` 和 `native-kernels/lizhao-office-pdf-ios/tests/test_compact_resources.py`。原 `test_run.py` 审计运输、真实 pkgconf/execve/进程组检查和 tools 的 builder/Apple 夹具仍由驱动按原执行位置运行；不运行旧 harness 或 size producer main。

artifact 仅上传本 job `evidence/logs/`，保存 1 天；仅原有界 JSON/两位编号命令与输出，加上两个明确 compact JSON。单文件 32MiB、总计 128MiB（含至少 1MiB 元数据预留）不变，不上传 binary、检查点、trace 或完整候选。完整编译 trace 留在受控构建树，最多 128MiB/50000 记录/每记录 128KiB，预算不足失败，不截断冒称完整。

final 的原完整审计最多 8MiB，map 原文最多 1GiB。原文 <=64MiB 用 raw 分块；较大 map 用完整 gzip+canonical base64，压缩上限 64MiB、块连续、单 member、CRC/尾随字节/完整 SHA 全核验。取证通道仍独立 120 秒，只读导出不延长原生构建预算。`LOG-TRANSPORT.json` 记录实际 bytes/SHA/上传情况；超限、陌生路径、链接、不可变原件变化或导出不完整都失败，不发布 final key。

本地 Python/模型/Clang 夹具与文本往返，只能证明对应层。新 Apple 完整构建、真实 cache、实际 Oz 覆盖、单 ICU 初始化、宿主调用链、四格式转换、签名/真机、IPA 与费用条件必须以本次实际新 run 独立复核。核心原生或资源改动后需要新 Apple 原生构建，最终插件接入需匹配 iOS 自定义基座；WGT 不能更新已有基座的原生 UTS 或内核。
